response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT ci.country, AVG(cs.points) AS avg_points, AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins FROM constructorStandings cs JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId JOIN circuits ci ON ci.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY ci.country) SELECT country, avg_points, avg_wins, avg_wins - AVG(avg_wins) OVER () AS wins_diff_from_country_avg FROM c ORDER BY country;

assumptions.assumption: Each constructorStandings row (one constructor after one race) is averaged as it stands, so every race at a country's circuits contributes equally per constructor row. The season-to-date points and wins values are averaged directly, with no reduction to final-season standings.

'The average of the country figures' is the unweighted mean of the per-country average wins, so each country counts once regardless of how many races it hosted. The difference is each country's average wins minus that mean.
